sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE date(crash_date) = '2026-07-01' AND weather_condition = 'CLEAR'
SELECT AVG(posted_speed_limit) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'WESTERN AVE'
SELECT DISTINCT prim_contributory_cause FROM crashes WHERE hit_and_run_i = 'Y'
SELECT v.make, COUNT(*) FROM vehicles v JOIN crashes c ON v.crash_record_id = c.crash_record_id WHERE c.posted_speed_limit = 30 GROUP BY v.make
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people p JOIN vehicles v ON p.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE p.person_type = 'DRIVER' AND v.make = 'TOYOTA'

SELECT c.crash_date, COUNT(v.crash_unit_id) FROM crashes c LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON c.crash_record_id = v.crash_record_id WHERE c.street_name = 'WESTERN AVE' GROUP BY c.crash_record_id, c.crash_date ORDER BY c.crash_date
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN hit_and_run_i = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM crashes WHERE date(crash_date) = '2026-07-01'

SELECT cc.category, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.crash_type = 'INJURY AND / OR TOW DUE TO CRASH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS injury_crash_rate FROM crashes c JOIN contributory_causes cc ON c.prim_contributory_cause = cc.cause GROUP BY cc.category ORDER BY injury_crash_rate DESC, cc.category
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE traffic_control_device = 'TRAFFIC SIGNAL' AND device_condition = 'FUNCTIONING PROPERLY'
SELECT SUM(injuries_total) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT DISTINCT make FROM vehicles WHERE vehicle_year = 2011
SELECT crash_type, COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE lighting_condition = 'DARKNESS, LIGHTED ROAD' GROUP BY crash_type
SELECT prim_contributory_cause, COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE injuries_incapacitating > 0 GROUP BY prim_contributory_cause
SELECT p.person_type, COUNT(*) FROM people p JOIN crashes c ON p.crash_record_id = c.crash_record_id WHERE c.street_name = 'WESTERN AVE' GROUP BY p.person_type

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vehicles v WHERE v.crash_record_id = c.crash_record_id AND v.towed_i = 'Y') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM crashes c WHERE c.street_name = 'FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'WESTERN AVE' AND lighting_condition = 'DARKNESS, LIGHTED ROAD'
SELECT MAX(posted_speed_limit) FROM crashes WHERE street_name = 'FULLERTON AVE'
SELECT DISTINCT model FROM vehicles WHERE make = 'TOYOTA' ORDER BY model
SELECT roadway_surface_cond, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crashes WHERE posted_speed_limit = 30 GROUP BY roadway_surface_cond ORDER BY cnt DESC, roadway_surface_cond
SELECT make, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vehicles WHERE occupant_cnt = 1 GROUP BY make ORDER BY cnt DESC, make
SELECT person_type, COUNT(*) FROM people WHERE age < 30 GROUP BY person_type ORDER BY person_type
SELECT crash_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crashes WHERE injuries_total > 0 GROUP BY crash_type ORDER BY cnt DESC, crash_type

SELECT street_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN hit_and_run_i = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hit_and_run_pct FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY hit_and_run_pct DESC, street_name

WITH s AS (SELECT street_name, SUM(injuries_total) AS total_injuries FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name) SELECT street_name, total_injuries FROM s WHERE total_injuries > (SELECT AVG(total_injuries) FROM s) ORDER BY total_injuries DESC, street_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE damage = 'OVER $1,500'
